title: Project discovery got a clearer map
summary:
A garden-maintenance day: clearer project docs, steadier text streaming, and one rescued README logo.

The projects list and its documentation were reorganized and refined, making it easier to browse what the community has built without treating the repository like an archaeological site.

The text.pollinations.ai streaming ad integration now handles its async flow correctly, keeping streaming responses coordinated instead of letting JavaScript improvise.

A broken logo image in the README was repaired, restoring a small but useful bit of orientation for people landing in the repo.
